title: Towards Safer Online Spaces: Simulating and Assessing Intervention Strategies for Eating Disorder Discussions

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring and comparing cognitive domain metrics (such as sentiment, empathy, and emotion) of simulated eating disorder conversations across different language models (Claude-3, Mistral, GPT-3.5-turbo, LLaMA3) and their specific versions to identify systematic variations in generated discourse tone and behavior.

Simulating and evaluating conversations across multiple distinct social media platforms (Twitter, Reddit, and ED Support Forum) and specific communities to identify variations in baseline sentiment and responsiveness to intervention strategies, thereby mitigating bias from focusing on a single community.
